COC7EXP.Settings.MoveMultiplier.Name: Movement multiplier (Move x N per turn)
COC7EXP.Settings.MoveMultiplier.Hint: How many times a token's Move stat it may travel during its turn on an Exploration Scene. CoC7's exploration rule default is 2. Also use this to compensate if the scene's grid distance unit doesn't match your table's Move unit.
COC7EXP.SceneConfig.Hint: Player token movement on this scene is capped at (Move x the movement multiplier setting) per turn, taken in a round-robin queue.
COC7EXP.Hud.Title: Exploration Turns
COC7EXP.Hud.NotExplorationScene: This scene is not flagged as an Exploration Scene.
COC7EXP.Hud.NoPlayers: No connected players own a token on this scene.
COC7EXP.NotYourTurn: It's not your turn to explore — waiting on {name}.
COC7EXP.Hud.YourTurnChat: It's your turn to explore! Open the Exploration Turn Tracker (hiking-boot icon) to see your movement budget and end your turn when done.
COC7EXP.MovementExceeded: That move exceeds your remaining movement ({remaining} left this turn).
COC7EXP.NoGMOnline: No GM is connected — the exploration turn tracker needs a GM online to record changes.
